- Helps me understand which modality is more informative
- Is not too complex (so I can attribute performance to specific choices)

- A single-modality setup (either RNA-only or image-only)
- Simplest encoder (PCA is the most standard, least parameterized)
- Single profile (simplest setup)

config_010: image_only, singleprofile, resnet50 - This is the simplest image baseline

3. Single profile avoids the complexity of aggregation
4. It establishes the RNA modality baseline
5. The next experiment can naturally be the image baseline (config_010) for comparison
6. Once I have both single-modality baselines, I can then test multimodal and know whether fusion actually helps

This is the most information-efficient starting point because it establishes a reference against which all other choices can be measured.

Let me go with config_001.
